name: Mix #5
description:
"Better Way" 

Electronic music producer Griffter is back with his 10th released single! This time he teams up with powerhouse vocalist Jessie Wagner (Chic, Lenny Kravitz, Duran Duran) to bring you this high-energy, pop/EDM song!

Griffter also teamed up with muralist and digital-artist, Dee Jae Paeste. With murals spanning San Jose, CA to Manila, Phillippines, Dee Jae's brings the energy of his Goddess' to this Async project. 

"It was important for me when deciding on the art direction, that we have an incredible female represented as the PFP to reflect the amazing voice of Jessie Wagner. I had seen Dee Jae's work through friends of mine and contacted him immediately when I saw his work, and the rest is kinda history..." - Griffter 

Each mint is the full-length version of the song for this Async Blueprints project. Spanning genres of Pop, Amapiano, EDM, Nu-Disco, and Tech House, each version is bound to have a character of its own! 

We're excited to bring you this full-length project and can't wait to see what you all mint! 

*137 Editions are available as 1, 3, and 7 are lucky numbers for Tiger's in the Lunar Zodiac Calendar, which Griffter is!
